title: Oliver’s Treasure Quest
moral: Courage and clever thinking lead to success.

scenes.summary: Oliver joins a pirate crew on a treasure adventure.
scenes.text: Oliver sailed with Captain Jack on the ship Jolly Roger. One day, they set out to find Treasure Island using a map.
scenes.image_prompt: young pirate with captain on ship holding treasure map cartoon children’s book style

scenes.summary: The crew faces rival pirates on the island.
scenes.text: When they reached the island, rival pirates attacked them, and a battle began.
scenes.image_prompt: pirate battle on island with swords and action cartoon style

scenes.summary: The crew explores the dangerous island.
scenes.text: They moved through jungles, crossed bridges, and avoided traps to reach the treasure location.
scenes.image_prompt: pirates exploring jungle with bridges and traps cartoon style

scenes.summary: Oliver faces the guardian and solves riddles.
scenes.text: A giant crab guarded the treasure. Oliver challenged it with riddles and solved them.
scenes.image_prompt: boy pirate solving riddles with giant crab guardian cartoon style

scenes.summary: The crew finds the treasure and celebrates.
scenes.text: The treasure was revealed, and Oliver proved his courage. The crew sailed away happily.
scenes.image_prompt: pirates celebrating treasure on ship sunset cartoon style

story: Oliver sailed with Captain Jack on the ship Jolly Roger in search of treasure. They reached Treasure Island and fought rival pirates. After winning, they explored the island and reached a hidden door. A giant crab guarded the treasure, but Oliver solved its riddles and proved his courage. The treasure was revealed, and the crew sailed away happily, proud of their adventure.
